_about: Rights ledger for pre-grader data. commercial_use: yes | no | unknown. A source that is not 'yes' may be used to measure, fit and evaluate privately (research_use) but its fitted weights must not ship in a paid product until the open question is settled. Checked 11 November 2026.

sources.name: jyesr/pokemon-tcg-grading (Hugging Face)
sources.what: 52,092 scans (front and back of about 26,000 Pokemon cards), 2400 px tall, with PSA cert id and PSA grade label in metadata.csv; 8 tar shards, 17 GB.
sources.license_note: No license on the dataset card. The pictures are PSA's own cert scans; the card artwork belongs to the game publishers.
sources.label_provenance: PSA grade as listed with a PSA cert id in the dataset's metadata. Not re-checked against PSA by us. The dataset card calls it the 'expected grade'; the cert ids and PSA grade names (GEM MT 10, NM 7 (MC), N0: AUTHENTIC) show they are cert records.
sources.status: USED for research fitting and evaluation. Quarantined from commercial shipping until the dataset author and PSA have been asked.

sources.name: pacoalberola/Poke-Grader-Dataset-Images-PSA (Hugging Face)
sources.what: 3,156 small photos (20-70 KB) of slabbed cards taken from eBay and PWCC listings; grades.csv with overall grade and four subgrades; sources ebay_psa 1325, pwcc_psa 914, ebay_cgc 445, ebay_bgs 392, pwcc_cgc 51, ebay_ace 29.
sources.license_note: No license. Marketplace listing photos belong to the sellers.
sources.label_provenance: Overall grade read from the slab/listing. The subgrades are NOT official: PSA does not issue subgrades, yet PSA rows carry values like 9.4. They are inferred or synthetic and must not be used as ground truth.
sources.status: NOT USED. Labels file inspected only. Too small to show corner or edge wear, slab plastic in front of the card, third-party photos, synthetic subgrades.

sources.name: lding101/pokemon-card-grades (Hugging Face)
sources.license_note: Gated: the owner's conditions must be accepted with a Hugging Face account.
sources.status: BLOCKED. HTTP 401 without an account that accepted the conditions. Not bypassed. Owner action: accept the conditions on Hugging Face and provide HF_TOKEN.

sources.name: Roboflow Universe: hansraj-kumar/pokemon-card-defect-detection v6
sources.what: Reported: 1,462 original images (4,097 with augmentation), boxes for corner wear, edge wear, scratches, dents, creases, delamination, ink loss.
sources.license: CC BY 4.0 (as listed; not confirmed by us because the page could not be opened)
sources.license_note: CC BY covers the annotations and the uploader's photos; it does not settle the card artwork. Attribution required.
sources.label_provenance: Community box annotations, quality not yet reviewed.
sources.status: BLOCKED. Exports need a Roboflow API key (free account); the Universe pages answer HTTP 403 to this machine. Owner action: create a key and set ROBOFLOW_API_KEY, then run fetch_roboflow.py.

sources.name: Roboflow Universe: one-piece-tcg/pokemon-surface-damage-detection-gfhuu v1
sources.what: Reported: 1,022 images, boxes for scratches, holes, creases, damaged corners, edge wear, tears, heavy wear. Pokemon cards despite the workspace name.
sources.license: CC BY 4.0 (as listed; not confirmed by us)
sources.label_provenance: Community box annotations, quality not yet reviewed.

sources.name: Roboflow Universe: one-piece-tcg/card-corner-a2c7o v6
sources.what: Reported: 533 original images with card corner keypoints.
sources.label_provenance: Keypoint annotations for locating a card, not condition labels.
sources.status: BLOCKED. Same as rf_defect. Low priority: the app already finds and straightens cards (CardRectifier).

sources.name: Coko7/vegapull-records (GitHub)
sources.what: One Piece card list and clean card images scraped from the official site.
sources.license_note: Card images belong to the publisher.
sources.label_provenance: Reference artwork only. Carries no condition information and must never receive damage or grade labels.
sources.status: NOT USED. The app already identifies One Piece cards from its own catalogue (OPTCG API) and picture index; clean artwork adds nothing to condition grading.

sources.name: Search for photos of physical One Piece cards with grades or defect labels
sources.what: Searched Hugging Face (queries: one piece card, one piece tcg, card grading, psa grade, card defect, tcg condition) and the web on 11 November 2026. Hugging Face: no One Piece dataset at all. Roboflow Universe: 'OP-Card Defect Tracker' is listed under CC BY 4.0 but shows 0 classes and no images; 'OnePieceCardRegions' labels card regions, not damage. Other hits are commercial grading apps, not data.
sources.status: NOTHING USABLE FOUND. One Piece grading cannot be calibrated from public data. The app measures One Piece centering and reports findings, marked provisional; verified samples have to come from the 'own' source.

sources.name: PSA, CGC and TAG certificate look-up pages
sources.what: Per-certificate pages with grade and sometimes pictures; TAG publishes detailed defect reports.
sources.license_note: Visible to the public is not the same as licensed for bulk download or model training.
sources.status: NOT USED. No scraping. The app's existing PSA lookup is for one certificate a user scans. Bulk data needs a written agreement with the grader.

sources.name: The owner's and users' own photos with a grade they received
sources.what: Phone photos taken in the app before a card was sent to a grader, joined later with the grade on the returned slab (verified-grade workflow, README.md).
sources.license_note: The only source that is both in the right domain (phone photos) and cleanly usable commercially.
sources.label_provenance: Verified: grade and cert number entered from the returned slab.
sources.status: EMPTY today. The app now exports these as training samples.
